authorized_scope: sudo systemd-run; existing encrypted credential path references only; isolated Java smoke cache OFF, then ten trials if ASR healthy without 403; stop temporary unit after ten; SIGKILL/restart not authorized
inspection: sudo -n grep of the two user-designated drop-ins only; credential directive identifiers/source paths emitted, Environment checks boolean-only; no credential content or Environment lines emitted
stop_reason: 99-system-models.conf exposes no LoadCredential*/SetCredential* directive; no authorized system-model credential path is available. Do not follow other configuration references or copy values.

sudo -n grep -oE '^[[:space:]]*SetCredential(Encrypted)?=' <one of the two recorded drop-in paths>

sudo -n grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*(LoadCredential|SetCredential)[A-Za-z]*[[:space:]]*=' /etc/systemd/system/lecturelens-live-backend.service.d/99-system-models.conf; exit status 1 means no directive; never print matching content
